Database Administrators are responsible for establishing database management systems, standards, guidelines and quality assurance for database deliverables, such as: conceptual design, performance tuning, logical database, capacity planning, external data interface specifications, data loading plan, data maintenance plan, and security policy.

The SQL Server DBA will be actively involved in the evaluation, review, and management of database resources and services across the organization to ensure optimum uptime and performance. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of configuring database infrastructure from the ground up in close association with peer teams and vendors. While providing the database expertise needed for the team's success, this individual will also be required to develop, follow and enforce database standards. This position will require an individual who can work with minimal supervision on a wide range of projects interfacing with development teams, business analysts, IS management and members of the business community while constantly ensuring that their work is aligned with the business and technology customers. The SQL Server DBA is also expected to stay current on database technologies while also continuing to gain Costco business knowledge.

If you want to be a part of one of the worldwide BEST companies "to work for", simply apply and let your career be reimagined.

ROLE
• Deploys and maintains Microsoft SQL Server databases/DB projects across a range of current SQL Server versions in both physical and virtual environments
• Maintains database security, integrity, and availability
• Manages database performance and capacity
• Ensures the database platform operations meet or exceed Compliance requirements
• Implements database design enhancements
• Collaborates with the Development team on creating and evaluating stored procedures, tables, indexes, etc.
• Maintains detailed documentation of database Design/Architecture and setup
• Establishes procedures for backup/recovery and disaster recovery
• Configures and monitors clustering including Always On and Failover clustering
• Designs and builds operational infrastructure to support our databases, automating where possible
• Establishes database security procedures
• Creates users, assign roles and manages permissions
• Maintains current knowledge of industry trends and standards
• Provides support to the user community using incident and problem management tools

REQUIRED
• At least 12 years' Administration experience in a relational database environment at enterprise scale including at least 8 years in-depth experience as a production SQL Server database administrator on current versions
• Strong knowledge of high availability and Disaster Recovery architecture
• Experience in Performance Tuning and Capacity Planning
• Strong Scripting and Programming skills including Python, PowerShell, Terraform (TFE)
• Expert knowledge and experience with Microsoft Azure database services and offerings or similar cloud platforms
• Extensive experience with Kerberos, encryption at rest and in transit, and other security topics
• Experience with Compliance requirements such as SOX, GDPR, CCPA, CPRA, MHMD as it relates to databases
• Able to support off-hours work as required, including weekends, holidays, and 24/7 on call responsibilities on a rotational basis

Recommended
• Current Certification in Microsoft SQL Server and Cloud Technologies
• Experience working with other Relational and NoSQL databases
• Good understanding of Vendor product Licensing and Support standards
• Ability to effectively communicate with Management and other key stakeholders
• Proficient in Google Workspace applications, including Sheets, Docs, Slides, and Gmail.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. MSSQL, MCDBA, MCTS, MCTP, or MVP certification may be considered in lieu of education.
• Four (4) years of experience in IT operations with a strong understanding of database structures, theories, principles, and practices.
• Two (2) years of experience in Database Administration for MS SQL Server, with demonstrated experience:
• Troubleshooting and resolving database problems.
• Performance Tunning and Optimization (PTO) using native monitoring and troubleshooting tools.
• Implementing operational automation using scripts.
• Managing High Availability (HA) and Disaster Recovery (DR) options.

• Technical Proficiency: Advanced knowledge of MS SQL Server, including installation, configuration, maintenance, and troubleshooting. Expertise in Performance Tuning and Optimization (PTO) using native monitoring and troubleshooting tools.

• High Availability and Disaster Recovery: Strong understanding of High Availability (HA) and Disaster Recovery (DR) solutions for MS SQL Server.
• Scripting and Automation: Proficiency in scripting languages such as T-SQL, PowerShell, and VBScript for automating database tasks and processes.
• Data Analysis: Ability to design and generate complex reports using SQL Reporting Services and provide advanced data analytics to support decision-making.
• Gaming System Expertise: Knowledge of gaming systems integration, including Bally’s servers and related software applications to support casino operations.
• Problem Solving: Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills to quickly diagnose and resolve database-related issues, ensuring minimal disruption to operations.
• Attention to Detail: Keen attention to detail to maintain data integrity, accuracy, and consistency across all database systems.
• Communication and Collaboration: Effective written and oral communication skills to document processes, write reports, and collaborate with internal stakeholders and external vendors.

Education and Experience:

About the position

The Boeing Company is looking for a Senior Database Administrator to join the team in Tukwila, WA; Berkeley, MO; Seattle, WA; Dallas, TX; Huntsville, AL; Mesa, AZ; El Segundo, CA; Long Beach, CA; Englewood, CO; Miami, Fl; Chicago, IL; Heath, OH; Oklahoma City, OK; Ridley Park, PA; Plano, TX; Arlington, VA; Everett, WA; North Charleston, SC; or Hazelwood, MO. The Database Administrator will join the Boeing SAP COE in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and will support SAP HANA and SQL Server infrastructures along with related ERP ecosystems and support systems. Our current environment includes a substantial footprint across HANA, SQL Server, and Oracle, and projections indicate the HANA environment could grow to three times its current size. This role involves close collaboration with Technical Architects, BASIS teams, and project teams to design and implement robust solutions across multiple SAP landscapes. The administrator will be responsible for installing, maintaining, and patching database software, monitoring SAP landscapes, investigating HANA and SQL Server performance issues, and performing environment system refreshes. The SAP Administrator will work with business process owners and SAP functional teams to configure databases to meet business requirements, requiring a solid understanding of SAP in-memory database technology. The position also requires familiarity with supporting hardware, Red Hat Linux, and Windows operating systems. The DBA will have experience with infrastructure and application support practices with the ability to work effectively within cross-functional teams spanning different functions and countries in a complex organizational structure.

Responsibilities
• Works on SAP HANA landscape, including the CPU, memory, and disk usage
• Performs maintenance and system monitoring, along with conﬁguration and application of any necessary patches
• Performs SAP source system conﬁguration and replication
• Ensures that the SAP HANA database is backed up regularly, and monitors and processes backup log files
• Performs the administration and operation of SQL Server systems related landscape components
• Provides support to non-SAP related Oracle systems
• Supports and leads critical project deliverables, provide coordination of priorities and tasks among a team of SAP COE Technical Professionals and consultants performing operational administration and implementation project support of a complex SAP ecosystem
• Implements corporate and organizational technology standards and evaluates the business needs regarding information management, systems, equipment, data, support, and training
• Collaborates with Technical IT Project leads and team members on the design and building of the SAP eco-system and infrastructure
• Serves as technical support for medium to complex problem resolution. Provide technical expertise for resolving escalated system issues. Participate in crisis meetings as necessary
• Ensures adherence to regulatory and compliance requirements within SAP System design and implementation
• Automates administrative and operational functions. Provide training and direction to operational teams
• Provides input and feedback on system design and implementation decisions regarding the SAP infrastructure and architecture in accordance with company policy
• Maintains technical knowledge of SAP system components and architecture
• Resolves incidents affecting the operation/availability of global systems, through troubleshooting and implementing known fixes
• Provides technical upgrades as well as functional and technical enhancements
• Troubleshoots the resolution of application and system errors
• Maintains the change processes within the SAP Landscape and the SAP Infrastructure according to accepted policy and procedures
• Implements and maintenances of HANA databases in coordination with user level security policy administered by SAP COE security team
• Evaluates and utilizes software products to assist in the management of data
• Collaborates with BW/BI developers/models for performance optimization and data access requirements in the HANA database environment
• Supports the tools including, LAMA, HANA Cockpit, HANA Studio, and Solution Manager
• Participates in on-call rotation to ensure 24/7 operations of these critical systems

Requirements
• 8+ years of experience administering SAP HANA, MS SQL Server, and Oracle databases within complex, large-scale production environments
• Experience deploying and managing SAP landscapes on Azure, including VM optimization, storage scaling, and cloud-native backup solutions

• Ability to work under on-call support schedules when required
